detail: Another way to check your blood glucose levels is to have an A1C blood test. Results of the A1C test reflect your averag

record.canonicalName: Use A1C test with adjusted targets during pregnancy

properties.statement: Another way to check your blood glucose levels is to have an A1C blood test. Results of the A1C test reflect your average blood glucose levels during the last 3 months. Changes in your body during pregnancy affect A1C levels. A1C test is not the best test to monitor your blood glucose level during pregnancy. Most people with diabetes should aim for an A1C of 6.5% or lower just before pregnancy. After the first 3 months of pregnancy, your target may be as low as 6%. These targets may differ from the A1C goals you’ve had in the past. Your health care team can help you set the A1C targets that are best for you.
